name: Button
description: The studio's action control. shadcn primitive, cva-variant, used everywhere a person triggers something. Composition layers wrap it; nothing re-implements it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. `surface` is the opaque one for floating over imagery; translucent variants disappear there.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height tier. The `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the styling onto the child element instead (Radix Slot).

root.description: One box; icon and label are children, gap comes from the size tier.

gaps.why: The palette carries one accent and one destructive; a third signal color is a token decision, not a component decision.
